context: Debug logging from a Bubble Tea program

checklist.name: logs_to_file
checklist.description: Sends logs to a file (for example `tea.LogToFileWith("debug.log", ..., log.Default())` or a logger built on the file), not stdout or stderr.

checklist.name: plain_text_profile
checklist.description: Ensures plain text in the file: builds a new logger on the file, or calls `SetColorProfile` (for example `colorprofile.Detect(f, os.Environ())` or `colorprofile.Ascii`) after redirecting the default logger, because `SetOutput` keeps the original terminal profile.

checklist.name: debug_level_timestamps
checklist.description: Sets debug level and enables timestamps.
